name: Butler Core Bridge
description: Admits managed Telegram messages to the local butler-core before dispatch, sets the receipt reaction after persistence and reports agent turn lifecycle and sent replies.

socket.label: Core socket
socket.help: Path of the butler-core Unix socket (default ~/.local/share/butler-core/core.sock)

timeoutMs.label: Admission timeout
timeoutMs.help: Milliseconds to wait for the core before the message passes through without a receipt (default 1200)
